policy.match_note: Observed TEE evidence is legitimate iff its registers match ANY record with status=active and now <= valid_until (when set), for the same `tee`. No per-model / per-image pin on the verifier.

retention.chain: model + role + tee (a chain rolls versions together)
retention.note: current + previous generation per chain stay ACTIVE so BOTH verify during AND after a rollout (the old generation keeps matching until the rollout completes, and is the rollback window). A record leaves the allowlist only when a 3rd newer generation lands in its chain (rebuild with --prune), or it is hard-expired / deprecated / revoked. Measurements change only at a rollout: there is no time-based re-capture.

policy.hard_expiry: valid_until is OPTIONAL and manual-only (e.g. throwaway canaries); absent = no expiry. A record past valid_until, or with status in {deprecated, revoked, retired}, never matches.
